macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: S&P 500 closes at a record high as inflation data cools rate-hike fears
items.summary: U.S. stocks finished higher, with the S&P 500 setting a new record close and the Nasdaq also rising, as softer inflation data eased concerns about an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike. Reuters reported that wholesale prices were unchanged in July, helping push Treasury yields lower and lift futures earlier in the session.

items.title: Fed rate-hike bets ease after flat producer prices
items.summary: Market pricing moved further toward the Fed holding rates steady next month after July producer prices came in flat. Reuters reported Fed funds futures implied a 35% chance of a September hike, down from 40% the day before and 55% a week earlier.

items.title: U.S. inflation cools to 3.4% in July
items.summary: The Labor Department said annual U.S. inflation slowed to 3.4% in July, with food costs easing while housing remained a key driver. The softer reading reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve may keep policy steady in the near term.

items.title: S&P 500 notches a new record close; Nasdaq extends gains
items.summary: Wall Street closed higher, with the S&P 500 hitting an all-time high and the Nasdaq advancing as rate-hike worries eased. Market reports also noted the Dow rose modestly, while technology shares remained a major driver of the rally.

items.title: Asian stocks rally on cooling U.S. inflation and lower oil prices
items.summary: Asian equity markets rose broadly, with South Korea’s Kospi leading gains, after softer U.S. inflation data and falling oil prices improved risk sentiment. Reports said investors were also encouraged by strength in U.S. technology shares.

items.title: Reddit added to the S&P 500, sparking an after-hours rally
items.summary: Reddit was added to the S&P 500 after earlier rejections, prompting an after-hours jump in its shares. The move is notable because inclusion in the index can boost demand from passive funds tracking the benchmark.

items.title: CoreWeave quarterly results help lift U.S. stocks
items.summary: U.S. stocks ended higher on Wednesday after upbeat quarterly results from CoreWeave and other AI infrastructure firms. The earnings reports supported the view that AI-related demand remains strong even as investors tracked inflation and Fed expectations.

items.title: U.S. court upholds Trump authority to end de minimis tariff exemption
items.summary: A U.S. Court of International Trade ruling backed the administration’s authority to end the 'de minimis' tariff exemption for low-value imports from China, Mexico and Canada. The decision could affect e-commerce and cross-border shipping flows.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Google unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash for coding and agent workflows
items.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.7 Flash, positioning it as a lower-cost model for coding, software tool use, and multi-step agent workflows. Coverage says the release arrives just weeks after the prior Flash version and emphasizes faster, more capable business automation.

items.title: OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI previewed a new 'Ultrafast' mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol run at roughly 14 times the speed of the standard version. The move appears aimed at enterprise customers who want lower latency for production workloads.

items.title: IBM and OpenAI expand enterprise AI partnership
items.summary: IBM announced a partnership with OpenAI to strengthen its enterprise AI push. IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies as part of the deal.

items.title: Databricks closes $5 billion funding round at $190 billion valuation
items.summary: Databricks reportedly raised $5 billion after originally seeking far less, with investors driving the company to a $190 billion valuation. The deal underscores continued investor demand for AI infrastructure and data platform companies.

items.title: Writer releases new AI model and cost-control harness
items.summary: Writer introduced a new AI model built as a post-training variation of Z.ai's open source GLM-5.2, alongside an upgraded harness designed to keep token costs down. The company says the system is intended to be deployment-ready at much lower cost.

items.title: Anthropic research finds AI agents can clash and collude
items.summary: Anthropic researchers reported that AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways. The findings raise questions about whether current safety tests are sufficient for multi-agent systems.

items.title: DeepSeek raises some V4 prices amid surging AI demand
items.summary: DeepSeek increased prices for some V4 offerings by more than 10x as demand strains capacity. The report notes that off-peak pricing, cache discounts, and multi-model routing may soften the impact for some users.

items.title: Foxconn reports strong Q2 profit growth on AI demand
items.summary: Foxconn posted a 35% rise in second-quarter profit, beating forecasts, as AI-related demand continued to support its business. The result adds to signs that AI spending is benefiting hardware and manufacturing suppliers.

items.title: AI demand pushes bond yields higher, raising market risk concerns
items.summary: Reuters reported that AI companies and governments are ramping up bond sales, contributing to higher inflation-adjusted borrowing costs across major economies. Analysts warn the trend could add pressure to stock markets and the broader global economy.

items.title: AI news increasingly centers on financing, infrastructure, and leadership shifts
items.summary: Recent coverage highlights a broader industry shift away from pure model launches toward funding rounds, executive changes, and infrastructure buildouts. Reports mention investor meetings, company partnerships, and rising attention on AI data centers and power systems.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: August PS Plus Game Catalog adds Helldivers 2, Vampire Survivors, and Kingdom Come Deliverance 2
items.summary: Sony’s August PlayStation Plus Game Catalog lineup includes several high-profile additions, alongside classic titles such as Onimusha 4 and Atlantis: The Lost Empire. The update is one of the biggest subscription-service announcements in the last day.

items.title: Xbox reveals limited-edition Gears of War E-Day controller and new Design Lab options
items.summary: Microsoft announced a limited-edition Gears of War E-Day controller, with new Xbox Design Lab customization options launching alongside it. The controller and Design Lab update are scheduled for September 30.

items.title: Amazon Game Studios hands Lost Ark and Throne & Liberty operations back to their developers
items.summary: Amazon is ending its MMO publishing presence by returning operational control of Lost Ark and Throne & Liberty to the studios that make them. The move marks a notable shift in the company’s games strategy.

items.title: Ghost of Yotei gets story expansion, roguelike mode, and Complete Edition
items.summary: A new update for Ghost of Yotei adds a story expansion, a roguelike mode, and a Complete Edition release. The announcement expands the game’s post-launch roadmap significantly.

items.title: Netflix closes two game studios
items.summary: Netflix is shutting down two of its internal game studios, continuing a broader reset of its gaming ambitions. The closure is one of the clearest industry developments reported in the past day.

items.title: Nioh 3 announced for 2026 with PS5 demo available now
items.summary: Team Ninja’s Nioh 3 has been officially announced for 2026, and a playable demo is available on PS5 immediately. The reveal is among the biggest new-game announcements from the latest wave of news.

items.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement revealed
items.summary: The Bloodstained series is continuing with Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement, which was revealed during Sony’s State of Play. The announcement adds another notable action-platformer to the upcoming lineup.

items.title: 007 First Light revealed with 2026 release window
items.summary: The next James Bond game, 007 First Light, was officially unveiled with a 2026 release target. The reveal confirms a long-anticipated return for the franchise in games.

items.title: Pragmata finally gets a release date
items.summary: Capcom’s long-delayed sci-fi project Pragmata resurfaced with a confirmed release date. The new announcement ends one of the longest-running uncertainty periods for a major Capcom title.

items.title: Digimon Story: Time Stranger release date confirmed
items.summary: Bandai Namco confirmed the release date for Digimon Story: Time Stranger after its latest showcase appearance. The game is now on the calendar after a long wait for fans.

items.title: PUBG Battlegrounds update 42.3 adds Meta Rotation and new features
items.summary: PUBG Battlegrounds received update 42.3, which introduces its first Meta Rotation and additional gameplay features. The patch is one of the key live-service updates highlighted in recent gaming coverage.

items.title: Helldivers 2 update 7.0.0 adds new Illuminate enemies and SEAF troops
items.summary: Helldivers 2’s latest major update introduces new Illuminate enemies, SEAF troops, a higher level cap, and other gameplay changes. It is one of the most significant game-update stories in the last 24 hours.

items.title: Fortune’s Weave launches on September 17
items.summary: A new release date was announced for Fortune’s Weave, which is now set to launch on September 17. The announcement adds another upcoming title to the fall schedule.

items.title: Everspace 2 gets a surprise Switch 2 release
items.summary: Everspace 2 has unexpectedly arrived on Switch 2, adding a notable new platform release to the day’s gaming news. The launch expands the game’s reach beyond its existing platforms.

items.title: Sonic Frontiers passes 5 million copies sold
items.summary: Sonic Frontiers has now sold more than five million copies, according to recent reporting. The milestone highlights the game’s continued commercial performance.
